arguments.name: qualificationCode
arguments.description: Search qualifications by code. Supports partial matching and returns all matching rows. Ignored when fetchMode is set to return all records.

raw.name: qualificationCode
raw.description: Search qualifications by code. Supports partial matching and returns all matching rows. Ignored when fetchMode is set to return all records.

arguments.name: qualificationName
arguments.description: Search qualifications by name. Supports partial matching (case-insensitive) and returns all matching rows. Ignored when fetchMode is set to return all records.

raw.name: qualificationName
raw.description: Search qualifications by name. Supports partial matching (case-insensitive) and returns all matching rows. Ignored when fetchMode is set to return all records.

arguments.name: fetchMode
arguments.description: Controls list retrieval. Use "ALL", "AVAILABLE", "EXISTING", or "LIST" to return all qualification records via Show All. When set, code/name search is skipped and all rows are returned.

raw.name: fetchMode
raw.description: Controls list retrieval. Use "ALL", "AVAILABLE", "EXISTING", or "LIST" to return all qualification records via Show All. When set, code/name search is skipped and all rows are returned.

arguments.name: returnAll
arguments.description: "all" | "available" | "existing" | "list" triggers show-all behavior (your existing style); truthy strings also trigger show-all (optional; supported)

raw.name: returnAll
raw.description: "all" | "available" | "existing" | "list" triggers show-all behavior (your existing style); truthy strings also trigger show-all (optional; supported)

arguments.name: autoFetchAllPages
arguments.description: truthy → fetch all pages and return all rows (default "true" when wantsAll)
